content: Vaze Aduga Odohe Tiburatihi

Nego nabudi, zaꞌe vine Zaḡoḡaniꞌa ibitoziꞌeteꞌe azaḡa ꞌahine, zae boꞌaḡano vaze ꞌahoganiꞌa haḡai sauꞌa haḡaeꞌeteꞌe horonoꞌidene, zaeꞌa namineꞌenaꞌa, ane haḡai bare mae dudunoꞌi. Ebu zae zuni haḡai sauꞌa haḡaihi rae raꞌeteꞌe zamaroneḡano mene uitifine zaeꞌa bare tohutohoꞌi.
Zae boꞌaḡano nagi aduga zuni odohe tiburanoꞌi. ꞌOugine, zaꞌe Keriso goro ḡoeꞌa hube hune hegote haḡaiꞌuma.
Vaze ꞌahogaꞌe niḡa ꞌoꞌoꞌa rehano, aneꞌa bare niḡa boro rae zamarine, ani ane bare soꞌoneꞌeteꞌe heuḡa.
Vaze tibatibaꞌe haḡaiḡa ḡianadu haḡai manoḡa ꞌahoga horonine, aneꞌa bare ane nigunogaꞌe idaḡa. Rehano vaze ꞌahoga haḡai teiteꞌe mene idatitiꞌuma,
mazaḡa anianine toheꞌe aneaneꞌa odohiꞌuma.
Badiꞌa ḡoere ihoreḡa igiꞌeteꞌe vazeḡaꞌe ḡau manoḡa niduꞌa ane ihore vazeḡa teite dainiꞌuma.
Za zae bare ago soꞌozoꞌi. Vaze ꞌahoganiꞌa Badiꞌa ni mae ovorogaꞌe mene idaḡa, mazaḡa vazeꞌa nagi ezoga ḡoraune, eꞌe huga hiriviꞌuma.
Iniuꞌa ahiriḡano ḡoraune, ahiriḡanonoꞌo rune
hiriviꞌuma, u Vine Zaḡoḡano ḡoraune, Vine Zaḡoḡanonoꞌo ḡabone tuḡutuḡu hiriviꞌuma.
Eꞌanoꞌo eme haḡai manoḡa haḡaeꞌeteꞌe zamaḡano zamafe mene zoreriꞌuma, mazaḡa eꞌe haḡaiḡa mene modine, Badiꞌaꞌa ohoniroteꞌe madaḡanoꞌe eꞌe naeḡa hiriviꞌuma.
Eꞌanoꞌo emeꞌa mada manoḡa ꞌahogaꞌahoga horonine, vaze niduꞌa mazao haḡai manoḡa haḡaiꞌuma. Nego nabudi fie tiburuꞌeteꞌe mazaoꞌe ufeta haḡae huniꞌuma.
Iradugu Riḡa Ḡoeꞌa zu Uhiu Ḡoeꞌa Ḡonaga
Ḡianoꞌi, eḡeꞌa ꞌevorehe hina zae veize ꞌahige borofe miriheꞌohe!
Iniuꞌe vazeꞌa niguzoga urateꞌeteꞌe azaḡaꞌe zaeꞌa ahiri rana iḡuri haḡaoga teꞌoteꞌauꞌohe. Aꞌe, Keriso satauro harameꞌeteꞌe uꞌano hideꞌeteꞌe adugaḡa ze mene meifine raꞌohe.

Ahiri rana iḡuri haḡairoteꞌe azaḡaniꞌa zuni Mose goro ḡoeꞌa mene hegoteꞌe rehano, ze zaeꞌa ahiri rana iḡuri haḡaeꞌeteꞌe urateꞌohe. Aꞌe zaeꞌa zeḡe ihore hegotadu ahiri rana iḡuri haḡaeꞌeteꞌe moneo zeḡeꞌa bare niguzoga veize raꞌohe.

Rehano e ḡauni ꞌahoga mene hune niguneꞌohe, rehano emeḡe Zuhiꞌa Boro Iesu Keriso satauro daꞌo niguneꞌohe. Iesu Keriso satauro uꞌano, raha gauḡa niduꞌaꞌe eḡe moneo rudaro, ebu eḡe zuni raha gauḡa niduꞌa moneo rudaro.
Ahiri rana iḡuri haḡaeꞌetaꞌaꞌe ga mene haḡaeꞌetaꞌaꞌe mene ḡau boro, rehano Badiꞌaꞌa haḡairoteꞌe ḡaboneḡa iziga rougaꞌe ḡau boro.
Badiꞌaꞌa goro ꞌahi hegoteꞌeteꞌe azaḡa niduꞌa zu Badiꞌa mone azaḡa
niduꞌa zama roḡeḡa zu vetuḡa ziniꞌenoꞌi.
Izidionoꞌo onamo zama moneo, vaze ꞌahoganiꞌa aduga ago enoꞌi, mazaḡa Iesu uꞌano meiroteꞌe bebeḡa nuꞌe ahiriheo ꞌada ꞌahine, e Iesu tuḡure vazeḡa rae ihozeꞌohe.
Nego nabudi, emeḡe Zuhiꞌa Boro Iesu Kerisoꞌa fureneꞌeteꞌe manoḡaḡaꞌe zae niduꞌa vineo radiuꞌenoꞌi. Amen.
